title: A DNA Typewriter records the cell lineage history of a mouse, from zygote to late organogenesis
title_zh: DNA打字机记录小鼠从受精卵到晚期器官发生的细胞谱系历史
abstract: Mammalian biology unfolds over time, within tissues and organs opaque to our eyes and instruments. We applied DNA Typewriter, a sequential molecular recorder, to record the cell lineage of a mouse over nearly two weeks of development. From one embryo, we reconstruct a time-calibrated, parsimony-supported, zygote-rooted phylogeny of 1.28 million transcriptionally profiled cells. A burst of editing unequivocally marks the daughters of the first cleavage, which serve as inline replicates. We quantify clonal dominance arising during gastrulation. Tree siblings share cell type far above chance; heterotypic siblings mark terminal differentiations. Temporal sweeps of clade co-occurrence recover a dated hierarchy of cell-type couplings; imputed labels for internal nodes recapitulate known state paths. A lineage-anchored ontogeny of mammalian development, long out of reach, is coming into view.
abstract_zh: 哺乳动物的生物学过程随时间展开，发生在对我们肉眼和仪器不透明的组织和器官中。我们应用 DNA 打字机——一种顺序分子记录器——记录了一只小鼠近两周发育过程中的细胞谱系。从一枚胚胎中，我们重建了一个时间校准、最简支持、以受精卵为根的 128 万个转录组测序细胞的系统发育树。一次编辑激增明确标记了第一次分裂的子细胞，它们作为内联复制品。我们量化了在胚层形成期间出现的克隆优势。树的兄弟姐妹共享的细胞类型远高于随机水平；异型兄弟姐妹标记终末分化。对分支共现的时间扫掠恢复了细胞类型耦合的有日期层级；对内部节点的推断标签重现了已知的状态路径。一个以谱系为锚点的哺乳动物发育本体论，长期难以触及，正逐步呈现。
